SELECT I.IF_CODE, I.IF_NAME, CASE I.INTERFACE_TYPE WHEN 'I' THEN 'Inbound' WHEN 'O' THEN 'Outbound' ELSE I.INTERFACE_TYPE END AS INTERFACE_TYPE_NAME, I.SOURCE_TABLE, I.TARGET_TABLE, I.HISTORY_TABLE, I.TRANS_PROGRAM_NAME, I.USING_YN FROM INTERFACE_ITEM_MST I WHERE I.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND I.USING_YN = #{using_yn}
AND I.IF_CODE ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%')
AND I.IF_NAME ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY I.IF_CODE

SELECT I.IF_CODE, I.IF_NAME, I.SOURCE_TABLE, I.TARGET_TABLE, I.HISTORY_TABLE, I.VRIFY_PROGRAM_NAME, I.SOURCE_PROGRAM_NAME, I.INTERFACE_TYPE, I.RETURN_COLUMN_NAME, I.RETURN_COLUMN_VALUE, I.RETURN_MSG_COLUMN_NAME, I.REMARK, I.USING_YN, I.TRANS_PROGRAM_NAME, COALESCE(TRIM(I.TRANS_COMPANY_CODE_YN), 'N') AS TRANS_COMPANY_CODE_YN, COALESCE(TRIM(I.TRANS_DIVISION_CODE_YN), 'N') AS TRANS_DIVISION_CODE_YN, COALESCE(TRIM(I.EXCEL_UPLOAD_YN), 'N') AS EXCEL_UPLOAD_YN, I.ATTRIBUTE01, I.ATTRIBUTE02, I.ATTRIBUTE03, I.ATTRIBUTE04, I.ATTRIBUTE05 FROM INTERFACE_ITEM_MST I WHERE I.IF_CODE = #{if_code} AND I.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code}

SELECT D.INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL_ID, D.IF_CODE, D.COLUMN_TRANS_TYPE, D.TARGET_COLUMN, D.SOURCE_COLUMN, D.HISTORY_COLUMN, D.COLUMN_NAME, D.COLUMN_TYPE, D.COLUMN_LENGTH, COALESCE(D.COLUMN_DCMLPOINT_LENGTH, 0) AS COLUMN_DCMLPOINT_LENGTH, D.COLUMN_FORMAT_FORM, D.COLUMN_DFLT_VALUE, D.COLUMN_VRIFY_PROGRAM_NAME, D.COLUMN_REQUIRED_YN, D.PK_YN, D.USING_YN, D.SAMPLE_DATA, D.ATTRIBUTE01, D.ATTRIBUTE02, D.ATTRIBUTE03, D.ATTRIBUTE04, D.ATTRIBUTE05 FROM INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL D WHERE D.IF_CODE = #{if_code} AND D.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} ORDER BY D.COLUMN_TRANS_TYPE, D.INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INTERFACE_ITEM_MST WHERE IF_CODE = #{if_code} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code}
